title: What the AI in Zaaheen does
text: Three small models Zaaheen uses three small AI models, each with one job: Understanding meaning , so a search for "my coffee order" also finds "I drink flat whites". It comes with the app. Ranking results , so the most relevant memories come first. The app downloads it the first time it starts. Tidying up , which merges duplicates and settles contradictions. The app downloads it once, about 2.5 GB, while you set up.

title: Where it runs
text: On your computer All three run on your own computer, using its processor. Once downloaded, they work offline, and your memories never pass through an online AI service on the way. That is why Zaaheen can promise that we never see your memories: there is no server in the middle to see them.

title: Zaaheen finds facts, your AI app answers
text: Your AI apps When an AI app such as Claude or ChatGPT asks Zaaheen a question, Zaaheen hands back the memories that match, as they are stored. It doesn't make up an answer or talk to you. The AI app you are using writes the reply, using those facts. Tidying up

title: What tidying changes
text: Consolidation Tidying up merges near-duplicates into one memory, settles facts that contradict each other in favour of the newer one, and moves memories you never use out of everyday recall. It also writes short summaries of each topic and adds other ways of phrasing a memory, so your AI apps find it whatever words they use. It works only from what you have saved and never deletes a memory. Like any AI, it can occasionally get something wrong, so check anything important before relying on it.

title: You decide when it runs
text: Settings Setup turns on Keep my vault tidy automatically , every day at 3 am, unless you choose Not now . You can change it to once a week, pick another time, run it yourself whenever you like, or turn it off, at any time. Our promises

title: Your memories never train AI
text: Always We never use your memories to train AI models, and we never give them to anyone who would. We couldn't even if we wanted to: they never reach us.

title: What your AI apps send to their makers
text: Your choice The AI apps you connect are made by other companies. When one uses a memory to answer you, it may send that memory to its maker's servers as part of your conversation. What happens next, including whether your conversations train their models, depends on that company's policy and your settings with them. You choose which apps to connect, and you can remove Zaaheen from any of them at any time. More about what we handle is in our Privacy Policy .

title: Where your memories are kept
text: Settings › Your memories On your own computer, encrypted. They are never uploaded. To keep them in another folder or on another drive, choose Move my memories… . Zaaheen closes, moves them, and opens again by itself. If it closes part-way, your memories stay safe where they were.

title: What tidying up (consolidation) does
text: Consolidation While you're away, Zaaheen organises what it has learned: it merges near-duplicates into one, resolves facts that contradict each other in favour of the newer one, and archives older memories you never use out of everyday recall. It never deletes them, and all of it happens on your computer. Setup turns it on, every day at 3 am, unless you choose Not now . You can change or turn it off under Consolidation . If your computer was asleep or off at that time, it catches up later. To tidy straight away, choose Run consolidation now . Zaaheen downloads what it needs, about 2.5 GB, once

title: How to take your memories with you
text: Settings › Your memories Choose Download my memories . It saves everything you've kept as one file. It's yours, whether or not you subscribe: the button stays available even after a trial or subscription ends.

title: How to delete everything
text: Settings › Your memories Choose Delete everything , type DELETE to confirm, then choose Permanently delete everything . This destroys the encryption key and the memory files, so it cannot be undone, and no encrypted copy can be unlocked again. Files you saved with Download my memories are readable copies that are not affected, so delete them yourself. Deleting your memories does not cancel your subscription; cancel that separately with Cancel subscription . Account and subscription

title: How the trial and subscription work
text: Settings › Account The first 30 days are free, with no card. After that it is $5 a month or $48 a year. To subscribe, choose Subscribe in the app: payment opens in your browser, and Zaaheen unlocks by itself once it goes through. To change your plan or update your card, choose Manage subscription . To stop it, choose Cancel subscription . Both are also on your Account page at zaaheen.com. Or use the cancel link in any email from Paddle, our reseller, which works from any device. If a trial or subscription ends, nothing is deleted. Everything stays on your computer, and you can still download i

title: How to delete your account
text: Settings › Account Choose Delete my account in the app. It offers to download your memories, deletes the memories on this computer, then opens a page where you confirm deleting your Zaaheen account. To delete only your account and keep your memories, use the Delete my account page on our website instead. Deleting your account cancels any subscription straight away, with no refund of the time left. If you paid in the last 14 days, ask for your refund first under our Refund Policy .

title: How to uninstall Zaaheen
text: Windows Settings or Applications Removing the app does not remove your memories, so reinstalling finds them again. To remove your memories as well, use Delete everything first. On Windows, use Windows Settings, then Apps, then Installed apps, and uninstall Zaaheen. On a Mac, quit Zaaheen, then drag it from Applications to the Bin. To free the space its downloaded AI engines use (several GB), also delete the folders ~/Library/Application Support/com.zaaheen.app and ~/Library/Logs/com.zaaheen.app . Help

title: My app isn't in the Agents tab
text: Agents An app shows in the Agents tab only while it is open and connected. Open the app, then check its own settings: each connection guide has a "Check it worked" step ( Claude Desktop , Claude Code , Cursor , ChatGPT ). If Zaaheen isn't listed there, connect it again.

title: ChatGPT can't see Zaaheen
text: ChatGPT Use ChatGPT's Work or Codex mode: its Chat mode can't connect to apps on your computer. Then check the setting: the Command must start exactly with C:\ , with no space or quote marks before it, and mcp and serve must be two separate items under Arguments, not one line. Quit ChatGPT completely and open it again. See Connect ChatGPT Desktop .

title: Claude didn't ask me to install Zaaheen
text: Claude › Extensions Zaaheen saves the extension to your Downloads folder. In Claude, open Settings, then Extensions, then Advanced settings, then Install Extension, and choose "Zaaheen for Claude.mcpb".

title: Windows says the publisher is unknown
text: Installer Choose More info , then Run anyway . If Microsoft Edge says the file "isn't commonly downloaded" first, choose the three dots next to the download, then Keep , Show more and Keep anyway . Zaaheen is in beta and its installer is not code-signed yet; signing comes later.

title: My Mac says to move Zaaheen to Applications
text: Mac Zaaheen runs only from the Applications folder. If you opened it from the disk image or from Downloads, quit it, drag Zaaheen into Applications in Finder, then open it from there.

title: My Mac asks whether Zaaheen can use the keychain
text: Mac The key to your memories is kept in your Mac's keychain, so macOS asks before Zaaheen reads it. Choose Always Allow . If Zaaheen says it couldn't use this computer's secure storage, open Keychain Access, unlock your login keychain, then try again.

title: My apps stopped using Zaaheen
text: Settings › Account If your free trial or subscription has ended, Zaaheen stops serving your AI apps until you subscribe. Nothing is deleted: your memories stay on your computer, and Download my memories keeps working. Choose Subscribe in the app, and your apps pick Zaaheen up again.

title: Something else went wrong
text: Settings › Help Choose Save activity record… in Settings, then email the file to customerservice@zaaheen.com with what you were doing. The record contains none of your memories. How to contact us . The key that unlocks it is kept in your computer's own secure store (Windows Credential Manager, or the keychain on a Mac) on the same computer. title: The AI that runs on your computer
text: On your computer Zaaheen uses small AI models to search your memories and to tidy them up (merging duplicates and settling facts that contradict each other). These models run on your computer, not on a server, so your memories never pass through an online AI service on their way. The app downloads the models the first time it needs them, from Hugging Face, a public library of AI models. The download sends nothing about you or your memories, but like any download, Hugging Face sees your computer's IP address. Zaaheen never uses your memories to train AI models.

title: What your AI apps do with your memories

What happens to it there is covered by that app's own privacy policy and your settings in it, including whether conversations are used to train its models. Zaaheen doesn't control that. title: Your memories are encrypted
text: At rest Your memories are encrypted on disk, and so is everything Zaaheen builds from them: the index it uses to search them and the summaries it writes when tidying up. Someone who copied the folder would see only scrambled data.

title: The key never leaves your computer
text: Your computer The key that unlocks your memories is created on your computer and kept in its own secure store for your user account: Windows Credential Manager on Windows, and your login keychain on a Mac. It is never uploaded, never sent to us, and never written into the memory folder itself.

title: Only apps on your computer can connect
text: Local only Your AI apps talk to Zaaheen through a private channel inside your computer. Zaaheen refuses connections from other computers and opens nothing to the internet, and each app has to introduce itself before Zaaheen answers. This also means Zaaheen cannot protect your memories from harmful software already running on your computer, or from someone who can sign in to your user account on it. Keep Windows or macOS up to date and your account protected with a password or PIN.

title: Delete everything means everything
text: Settings › Your memories Delete everything destroys the key first, then the memory files. Without the key, any encrypted copy of those files left on the disk or in a backup of your computer can never be unlocked again. Files you saved with Download my memories are readable copies that are not affected, so delete them yourself. Online
